text:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: need final statuspage wording + customer summary + a clear RCA-access flow. Legal flagged sensitive traces in logs. Also noticed recurring cache-eviction spikes in three incidents. Assign owners?

omar: I can draft the statuspage blurb now. Will keep it short and plain.

jess: I'll own the customer-facing summary and the consent checkbox language. Proposal: publish a public technical summary on status and offer an expanded internal report to affected enterprise customers on request, with CSM confirmation + signed consent/NDA for any logs.

legal: Legal prefers the term "technical summary" for public posts. Do NOT include raw request text, internal IPs, or unredacted traces. We'll provide a consent template and redaction checklist.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-711 0assigned to @nina

nina: Omar, paste status draft here. Jess, can you target Tue EOD for the customer note? Also need a remediation ticket owner for the eviction pattern.

omar: Draft status copy:
```
Status: Partial degradation of text-generation API.
Impact: increased latencies and transient errors for a subset of requests between 01:10-01:40 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated after rollback; monitoring.
Next steps: A technical summary will be published on the status page and a customer-facing note will be shared by <date>.
```

jess: Add: "Data integrity: no customer data was altered or lost." I'll draft the email + brief consent checkbox: "I consent to receive a redacted internal report under a signed consent form/NDA." Posting drafts Tue EOD.

nina: Decision: public technical summary + expanded internal report on request for affected enterprise customers only. Require CSM vet + signed consent/NDA for logs/traces. Owners: omar (status copy), jess (customer summary & consent text), nina (incident board). Deadlines: status now, customer note Tue EOD, remediation ticket TBD.

omar: ack :thumbsup:

jess: ack, will post drafts.

nina: I'll update the incident board and schedule an async review tomorrow 10:30am PT. If Legal has edits, drop them here so we can iterate before pushing to staging.
